title: Which Scorecard Comes First?
description: South Korea checks NVIDIA’s chip supply plans, ransomware researchers examine attack claims, and a wet-lab benchmark tests AI predictions against experimental results. AWS counts the cost of a coding agent completing a task.

korea-gpu-supply-after-huang.topic: South Korea confirms NVIDIA's supply plans after leadership change, while Taipei tracks its headquarters project
korea-gpu-supply-after-huang.verification_scope: TechCrunch's reporting on the responses of the governments concerned.

nvidia-venture-capital-followup.topic: Startups worry that NVIDIA's leadership change could make their first GPUs harder to finance
nvidia-venture-capital-followup.verification_scope: TechCrunch interviews with investors and founders.

ransomware-language-and-negotiation.topic: Ransomware groups use AI for phishing and negotiation. What do their attack claims actually measure?
ransomware-language-and-negotiation.verification_scope: WIRED interviews with security researchers. The groups' individual claims were not independently verified.

bedrock-coding-agent-cost.topic: AWS counts failed attempts when it prices a coding agent's successful tasks
bedrock-coding-agent-cost.verification_scope: AWS engineering blog and benchmark documentation. The benchmark was not run for this issue.

helen-toner-policy-research.topic: How Helen Toner gets technical research into policymakers' hands
helen-toner-policy-research.verification_scope: The Decoder transcript, specifically the discussion of how the policy research team worked.

spu-predict-hidden-experiments.topic: Can AI rank the outcomes of wet-lab experiments before it sees the results?
spu-predict-hidden-experiments.date_note: Preprint submitted November 11 and covered November 14
spu-predict-hidden-experiments.verification_scope: Methods, Table 1, results and limitations in version 1 of the arXiv preprint. The experiments were not reproduced.

jaderberg-experiment-feedback.topic: Max Jaderberg on drug discovery: what should carry over to the next experiment?
jaderberg-experiment-feedback.date_note: Interview released November 12 and cataloged November 13
jaderberg-experiment-feedback.verification_scope: The published Concourse page and its editorial paraphrase of the specified passage. No verbatim quotation is attributed to the speaker.

langchain-openai-python-support.topic: Before upgrading langchain-openai to 1.8.0, check Python and langchain-core
langchain-openai-python-support.date_note: Released November 13 UTC, included in the 48-hour follow-up
langchain-openai-python-support.verification_scope: Official release notes and repository license. No installation test was performed.

lauren-tan-verifying-agent-code.topic: How Lauren Tan's team checks code written by agents
lauren-tan-verifying-agent-code.date_note: Original talk dated November 14 and cataloged November 15
lauren-tan-verifying-agent-code.verification_scope: The publisher's episode notes and chapter list. The talk was not checked line by line against the recording.
